title: Recipe and Yearbook
author: L. M. Reyes
blurb: Xanthe Crane, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
